items.name: 2 Eggs - Scrambled
items.description: Two whole farm-fresh eggs cracked directly onto a medium-heat flat-top grill, whisked quickly with liquid soybean oil, and cooked until soft, fluffy, and fully set.

items.name: Classic Waffle
items.description: Sweet cream waffle batter poured into a preheated commercial waffle iron, baked for 2.5 minutes until golden brown, and served hot with a dollop of whipped butter.

items.name: White Toast (2 Slices)
items.description: Two slices of classic enriched white bread lightly brushed with butter spread and toasted golden brown on a flat grill.

items.name: Wheat Toast (2 Slices)
items.description: Two slices of whole wheat bread lightly buttered and toasted on the grill top.

items.name: Raisin Toast (2 Slices)
items.description: Cinnamon raisin bread slices toasted on the grill and finished with warm butter spread.

items.name: Grilled Biscuit
items.description: A flaky Southern buttermilk biscuit split in half, buttered, and grilled face-down until toasted crisp.

items.name: Texas Toast (1 Slice)
items.description: One extra-thick slice of white Texas toast bread buttered heavily and grilled on both sides.

items.name: Grits
items.description: White stone-ground corn hominy boiled with water, salt, and butter until smooth and creamy.

items.name: Regular Hashbrowns
items.description: Shredded potatoes scattered loosely on a hot flat-top grill coated with oil and seared until golden and crispy.

items.name: Sliced Tomatoes
items.description: Fresh red ripe tomatoes sliced thick and served cold as a fresh side.

items.name: Bacon (3 Slices)
items.description: Three strips of hickory-smoked pork bacon griddled on the flat top until crispy.

items.name: Sausage (2 Patties)
items.description: Two seasoned pork sausage patties grilled thoroughly until seared brown on the outside.

items.name: Chicken Sausage (2 Patties)
items.description: Two savory lean chicken sausage patties grilled flat until fully cooked.

items.name: City Ham (1 Slice)
items.description: Sliced hickory-smoked city ham warmed and seared on the grill.

items.name: Country Ham (1 Slice)
items.description: A thick cut of traditional salty, dry-cured country ham grilled until hot and fragrant.
